nanananda_verbatim:
Where are the actors and actresses who played their part in the early
acts of our drama of life?... Though they are no more, so long as
latencies to perception, amassed through them, persist in us, there is
nothing to prevent us from indulging in thoughts and proliferations.
plain_english_below: Where are the actors and actresses who played their part in the early acts of our drama of life?... Though they are no more, so long as latencies to perception, amassed through them, persist in us, there is nothing to prevent us from indulging in thoughts and proliferations.

nanananda_verbatim:
The worldling creates his own form, feelings, perceptions, preparations,
and consciousness — as a painter fashions a likeness on a board.
plain_english_below: The worldling creates his own form, pleasant-or-unpleasant tone, perceptions, things the mind makes, and consciousness — as a painter fashions a likeness on a board.
tts_line: The worldling creates his own form, pleasant-or-unpleasant tone, perceptions, things the mind makes, and consciousness — as a painter fashions a likeness on a board.

nanananda_verbatim:
Form like foam, feeling like bubble, perception like mirage, volitions
like plantain trunk, consciousness like an illusion.
plain_english_below: Form like foam, pleasant-or-unpleasant tone like bubble, perception like mirage, volitions like plantain trunk, consciousness like an illusion.
tts_line: Form like foam, pleasant-or-unpleasant tone like bubble, perception like mirage, volitions like plantain trunk, consciousness like an illusion.

nanananda_verbatim:
With the cessation of that concept of a gem as some special thing, a
valuable thing, separate from the rest of the world... the gem ceases
to exist. That itself is the deliverance.
plain_english_below: With the stopping of that concept of a gem as some special thing, a valuable thing, separate from the rest of the world... the gem ceases to exist. That itself is the deliverance.
tts_line: With the stopping of that concept of a gem as some special thing, a valuable thing, separate from the rest of the world... the gem ceases to exist. That itself is the deliverance.

nanananda_verbatim:
He declares that he has seen well in advance 'the barb on which
mankind is hooked impaled'. The barb is none other than the dogmatic
assertion, 'I know, I see, it is verily so'.
